name: Pushpay
shortDescription: A digital giving, church management, apps and analytics platform for churches and parishes in selected countries.
suitableContexts: Churches in Pushpay’s supported countries seeking a sales-led engagement suite
Teams comparing ChurchStaq’s giving, ChMS and apps bundle

pricing.summary: Pushpay asks churches to request pricing through a no-obligation demo. It states that customers must be located in the USA, Canada, New Zealand or Australia, so this is not currently a UK purchasing option.

tiers.label: Giving
tiers.detail: Supplier provides plans through a demo and pricing conversation

tiers.label: ChurchStaq
tiers.detail: Supplier describes Core, Advanced and Complete package options

support: Weekend support for urgent service issues stated by supplier

editorial.assessment: Pushpay is a substantial commercial church platform, but its own current pricing page says customers must be based in the USA, Canada, New Zealand or Australia. It is included for market context and should not be presented as available to UK churches without direct supplier confirmation.
bestFor: Churches located in a supported country seeking giving and engagement tools
UK teams researching overseas market options rather than buying now
strengths: Broad giving, ChMS, app and engagement coverage
limitations: UK customer availability is not supported by the supplier’s published country list
Pricing is quote based and Gift Aid is not confirmed

longForm.verdict: Pushpay is useful as a reference point for an integrated giving-and-engagement platform, but its published customer-location restriction makes it unsuitable for a normal UK shortlist at present.

decisionLens.heading: Availability is the first requirement, before feature comparison.
decisionLens.text: The supplier states that customers must be located in the USA, Canada, New Zealand or Australia. A UK church should not spend implementation time comparing integrations or finance features until Pushpay confirms a current UK route in writing.

sections.heading: A platform for supported markets
sections.question: Is the church eligible to become a customer?
paragraphs: Pushpay describes digital giving, ChMS, apps and analytics through its ChurchStaq platform, with text, volunteer, event and check-in features in its church-management product.

Its published pricing FAQ limits customers to four countries and does not list the UK. Treat the platform as contextual research only unless the supplier confirms a UK contract, payment support, privacy terms and finance workflow.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on Pushpay’s official pricing and product pages.
themes: The platform is broad, but availability rules are decisive.
Quote-based products require a written scope even in supported countries.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier product claims are not independent testing and do not establish UK availability.

faq.question: Can a UK church buy Pushpay?
faq.answer: Not according to the supplier’s published pricing FAQ, which says customers must be located in the USA, Canada, New Zealand or Australia. Ask Pushpay directly if this changes.

faq.question: Does Pushpay publish prices?
faq.answer: No public price list was found. Pushpay invites churches to request a no-obligation demo for pricing options.

faq.question: Does Pushpay support UK Gift Aid?
